segments.name: Production & Precision Agriculture
products: Soil Preparation, Tillage, Seeding, Application, and Crop Care Equipment
segments.description: Delivers equipment and precision technology solutions for production-scale growers of crops like corn, soy, small grains, cotton, and sugarcane.
segments.evidence: This segment defines, develops, and delivers global equipment and technology solutions for production-scale growers of crops like large grains (such as corn and soy), small grains (such as wheat, oats, and barley), cotton, and sugarcane.

segments.name: Small Agriculture & Turf
products: Riding Lawn Equipment and Commercial Mowing Equipment
segments.description: Provides equipment and technology solutions for dairy and livestock producers, high-value and small acre crop producers, and turf and utility customers.
segments.evidence: SAT is committed to meeting the needs of our customers through defining, developing, and delivering global equipment and technology solutions for dairy and livestock producers, high-value crop and small acre crop producers, and turf and utility customers.

segments.name: Construction & Forestry
products: Road Building and Road Rehabilitation Equipment
Articulated Dump Trucks and Motor Graders
segments.description: Manufactures and distributes earthmoving, roadbuilding, and forestry equipment for construction and timber customers.
segments.evidence: Equipment manufactured and distributed by the segment includes four-wheel-drive (4WD)/track and row crop tractors, harvesters, cotton pickers, cotton strippers, sugarcane harvesters, sugarcane loaders, and related harvesting front-end equipment.

segments.name: Financial Services
segments.description: Finances John Deere equipment, parts, services, and other inputs for customers through retail notes, leases, and related financial products.
segments.evidence: John Deere Financial provides financing for John Deere equipment, parts, services, and other inputs customers need to run their operations.

revenueModel.text: Customers and dealers pay for equipment sold primarily through independent dealer networks, while Financial Services earns revenue from financing retail notes, leases, and wholesale receivables.
revenueModel.evidence: SAT equipment is sold primarily through independent retail dealer networks, although the segment also builds turf products for sale by mass retailers, including The Home Depot and Lowe's.

changes.text: In 2025, Banco John Deere S.A. (BJD) was deconsolidated, affecting Financial Services results.
changes.evidence: The average balance of receivables and leases financed was 5% lower compared to the prior year, primarily due to the deconsolidation of BJD (see Note 4).
